**Indikator 2b** is a clinical quality indicator managed by the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] that measures the proportion of ADHD diagnostic assessments for children and adolescents aged 6–17 where a manualized diagnostic interview or environmental observation is conducted within 120 days of the assessment's start [^src1]. It serves as a critical metric for evaluating the application of evidence-based diagnostic methods in the Danish healthcare system [^src4]. 

Historically, Indikator 2b was split from [[indikator-2a|Indikator 2a]] because the original indicator covered two distinct but equally important assessment elements for patients over the age of six [^src4]. The indicator accepts several semi-structured diagnostic interview methods, including [[kiddie-sads|Kiddie-SADS]], [[pse-scan|PSE-SCAN]], and [[dawba|DAWBA]] [^src5]. The established quality standard and development target for this indicator is [[90-percent|90%]] [^src2].

Despite its clinical importance, Indikator 2b has revealed systemic weaknesses in standardized diagnostics. In the 2023 reporting period, the national fulfillment rate was only 48%, the lowest among all indicators, falling significantly short of the 90% standard [^src1]. Regional variation was stark, ranging from 31% in [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], and North Jutland, to 77% in [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] [^src2]. In the subsequent 2024 reporting period (01.04.2023–31.03.2024), the national average slightly improved to 51% (2,513 out of 4,942 assessments) but remained well below the target [^src4]. Regional disparities persisted, with [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] at 32% and [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] leading at 70% [^src6]. [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] showed an upward trend, attributed to focused efforts on improving registration practices and shortening the duration of ongoing assessments [^src6].

At the departmental level, performance varies dramatically. High-performing units include [[odense-borne-og-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|Odense: Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] (94%) [^src5], [[aabenna-borne-og-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|Aabenraa: Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] (93%) [^src5], and [[bua-smaborn-klinik|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn]] (94%) [^src5]. Conversely, [[hejmdal-privathospital-viby-beh-afsnit|Hejmdal Privathospital Viby, beh.afsnit]] recorded a 0% fulfillment rate [^src5].

Due to these persistent shortfalls and the need to better reflect distinct clinical requirements, the [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] decided to revise the indicator [^src2]. It has been split into two new indicators with updated definitions to better capture separate assessment elements [^src4], resulting in the creation of [[indikator-2b-new|indikator-2b-new]] [^src6]. One of the revised indicators will specifically focus on information gathered from institutions and schools [^src2].

  Page: 6

  Source: wikis/rkkp-adhd/raw/ADHD_2023.pdf, pages 6-10 [^src1]

## Timeline
- 2023/24: Referenceperiode for sammenligning af Indikator 2a og Indikator 2b, hvor 59 % og 49 % opnåedes på landsplan. (indikator-2a, indikator-2b) [^src4]
- 2022/23: Referenceperiode for sammenligning af Indikator 2a og Indikator 2b, hvor 67 % og 43 % opnåedes på landsplan. (indikator-2a, indikator-2b) [^src4]
- 01.04.2024 - 31.03.2025: Opgørelsesperiode for Indikator 2b og Indikator 3 (indikator-2b, indikator-3) [^src4]
- 2023/24: Forrige opgørelsesperiode for Indikator 2b og Indikator 3 (indikator-2b, indikator-3) [^src4]
- 2022/23: Opgørelsesperiode for Indikator 2b og Indikator 3 to år tidligere (indikator-2b, indikator-3) [^src4]
